BOSS_BATTLE_NAME_WorldTreeMiddleBoss3.title: Highly Modified Pal Bosses
BOSS_BATTLE_NAME_WorldTreeMiddleBoss3.note: Eight modified tower boss pals over four waves rather than one fight. Clearing it drops the Pal's Containment Core, one of the three materials that open the Sealed Sanctum.

BOSS_BATTLE_NAME_WorldTreeBoss.title: Nullstar Calamity
BOSS_BATTLE_NAME_WorldTreeBoss.note: Typeless, so no element counters it — the fight is about uptime rather than a matchup.

PalSummon_NightLady_Dark.title: Twilight Siren
PalSummon_NightLady_Dark.note: Opens as Dark and turns Ice for its second phase, so a team built for one half struggles in the other.

PalSummon_KingBahamut_Dragon.title: Incarnation of the Eternal Flame
PalSummon_KingBahamut_Dragon.note: Switches from Fire to Electric damage below about 10% HP.

PalSummon_LegendDeer.title: King of Salvation
PalSummon_LegendDeer.note: Raises barriers that have to be broken inside 15 seconds, which takes both Electric and Fire damage on the team.
